projects.title: Self-Hosted DevOps Stack
projects.blurb: Production platform I operate: Docker Swarm, Nginx with TLS via Certbot, a private registry and Git server, Drone CI, and one pipeline for metrics, logs, and traces.
highlights: Gitea + Drone CI pipelines to build and deploy

projects.title: ZenTrace
projects.blurb: TypeScript tracing library for production debugging. It records which functions ran, how the async flow moved, and the logs and HTTP calls on each step, then shows that path in Chrome DevTools.
highlights: Trace class methods with @trace() and plain functions with traceFn()
Span tree, timeline, and inspector for arguments and return values
console and fetch linked to spans, exported to Zipkin and Loki

projects.title: TVOne News Portal
projects.blurb: News platform on NestJS and Next.js. Redis caches article delivery. RabbitMQ carries publish and notification work off the request path.
highlights: API and editorial workflows powered by NestJS
Redis-backed caching for fast article delivery
RabbitMQ queues for publish and notification jobs

projects.title: Holistic Life Organizer
projects.blurb: Personal platform with Keycloak for sign-in, a NestJS API, PostgreSQL for state, and a Flutter client for habits, scheduling, and an organic garden planner.
highlights: Keycloak in front of the API
Habit tracking and a progress dashboard

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.blurb: Storefront with secure payments, real-time order processing, and infrastructure aimed at staying available under load.
highlights: Catalog, cart, and an admin panel for products and users

projects.title: Reactive Portfolio Website
projects.blurb: This site. Next.js in English and Portuguese, with live visitor presence over Socket.io.

bullets: Reliability: Connected production platforms to logs, metrics, and tracing, raising overall system stability by 15%.
Payments: Built EMIS-compliant payment flows, including automatic direct-debit subscriptions for recurring collections.
Financial correctness: Built modules that generate and validate bank collection files (IDD pacs.003), reducing operational errors in transactions.
Internal platform: Delivered institutional calendars, K2 workflows, and real-time messaging as one digital workplace.
Incident diagnosis: Implemented distributed tracing and observability that cut critical-failure resolution time by 40%.
Load: Built background task processing in the interface, improving response time and how compute was used.
Delivery: Built responsive portals and inventory systems for operations teams.
Automation: Built scripts that filled internal hospital documentation, removing repetitive work from the administrative team.
E-commerce: Built the portal interface, including light and dark themes and a fast-loading page structure.
